meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次成功修改或写入文件,插件就会自动检查代码注释;若发现警告,Claude 需先修复或解释有问题的注释,处理完才继续。
howto.when: 在 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作成功完成后触发;若检查出注释警告,会要求 Claude 先修复或解释再继续。

say.text: 帮我改下这段代码,改完顺便检查注释有没有问题。
say.note: 修改完成后会自动运行 comment-checker。

say.text: 刚才有个注释警告,请修复它。
say.note: Claude 会处理先前报告的阻塞反馈。

say.text: 如果这条注释不合规范,请解释一下。
say.note: Claude 依据检查反馈给出说明。

howto.what_en: After install, each successful file modification or write triggers an automatic comment check. If a warning is raised, Claude must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after an edit-like successful PostToolUse hook (e.g., apply_patch, write, edit); when a comment warning is found, Claude is asked to handle it first.

say_en.text: Modify this code, then also check the comments for issues.
say_en.note: Comment-checker runs automatically after the edit.

say_en.text: Fix the comment warning from earlier.
say_en.note: Claude will resolve the blocked feedback.

say_en.text: If this comment is not compliant, please explain.
say_en.note: Claude will interpret the checker feedback.
